# Migration Intentions - v1.2.0

## Intentions

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:begin — generated by `pnpm boilerplate intentions sync`, do not edit -->

- [`00-adopt-published-cli.md`](./00-adopt-published-cli.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The project runs `pnpm boilerplate` and `pnpm rock` through the published `@lonestone/boilerstone-cli`, called with `pnpm dlx`. The CLI is not a dependency of the project, and no CLI TypeScript is vendored under `.boilerstone/cli/` or `cli/setup.ts`.
- [`01-api-image-mikro-orm-prefer-ts.md`](./01-api-image-mikro-orm-prefer-ts.md) — `migration` · `docker-env` — The API Docker image sets `MIKRO_ORM_CLI_PREFER_TS=false`, so `pnpm db:migrate:up` discovers the compiled entities in `dist/` and the container can start.
- [`02-auth-string-fields-as-text.md`](./02-auth-string-fields-as-text.md) — `migration` · `auth` — `auth generate` emits `@Property({ type: 'text' })` for every Better Auth `type: "string"` field, and any already-generated JWKS `publicKey` / `privateKey` columns are unbounded `text` rather than `varchar(255)`.
- [`03-check-merge-settings-free-plan.md`](./03-check-merge-settings-free-plan.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The consumer repository squash-merges with the pull request title and description as the commit, and its settings docs say that required checks are advisory on a private repository on the GitHub free plan.
- [`04-contribution-paragraphs-and-coauthors.md`](./04-contribution-paragraphs-and-coauthors.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — `CONTRIBUTING.md` says how a conventional paragraph must be laid out and asks for AI co-author trailers at the end of the description. The `finalize-pr` skill validates the description with `pnpm lint:pr` before applying it and keeps those trailers.
- [`05-filter-langfuse-spans.md`](./05-filter-langfuse-spans.md) — `migration` · `ai` — Every `LangfuseSpanProcessor` in `apps/api/src/instrument.ts` exports only LLM-related spans (`langfuse-sdk` and `ai`), including the Langfuse-without-Sentry path.
- [`06-openapi-generator-docs-url.md`](./06-openapi-generator-docs-url.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The OpenAPI generator waits on and fetches `${API_URL}/docs.json`, and `API_URL` already includes the API global prefix (`http://localhost:<port>/api`). A missing spec fails loudly instead of writing a 404 body to `tmp/openapi.json`.
- [`07-pre-bundle-lazy-route-deps.md`](./07-pre-bundle-lazy-route-deps.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — Every React Router app sets `future.unstable_optimizeDeps: true` in its `react-router.config.ts`, so the Vite dependency scanner sees the client entry and all route modules at server start.
- [`08-rewrite-workspace-scope-imports.md`](./08-rewrite-workspace-scope-imports.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — After a project rename, workspace imports, tsconfig paths, shadcn aliases, docs, and CI filters use `@<project>/ui`, `@<project>/openapi-generator`, and `@<project>/i18n` — not `@boilerstone/`.
- [`09-sentry-traces-sample-rate.md`](./09-sentry-traces-sample-rate.md) — `migration` · `monitoring` — Sentry `tracesSampleRate` comes from `TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` (0–1). The default is `0`, so errors and logs still flow while traces stay off until a project opts in.
- [`10-slim-lefthook-pre-push.md`](./10-slim-lefthook-pre-push.md) — `migration` · `ci` — `lefthook.yml` `pre-push` streams lint and typecheck with `follow: true`. It does not read stdin, skip on a `(delete)` line, or run `pnpm test`. Tests stay in CI. Lint and typecheck are separate piped jobs (no POSIX `|| exit 1` script). The commit-msg path is quoted as `"{1}"`.
- [`11-upgrade-vite-8.md`](./11-upgrade-vite-8.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — SPA and SSR apps resolve Vite 8.2.2 (Rolldown/Oxc), `pnpm-workspace.yaml` pins that version in `catalogs.build` and `overrides`, and each Vite config uses native `resolve.tsconfigPaths: true` instead of `vite-tsconfig-paths`.

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:end -->
